title: Theming
summary: Wrap once, provide a theme, and brand every Marwes component.
heading: One provider, one theme boundary
description: Marwes components consume resolved theme values from the framework provider and ship static preset CSS. There is no CSS-in-JS runtime in the component packages.
calloutBody: Use useTheme() when JavaScript needs resolved values. The styled theme contains CSS variable references whose definitions live below the document root.
